FIELDS.NAME: Trophy Master Awards
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Trophy Master Awards specializes in the retail of customized trophies and awards, serving a diverse clientele including sports teams, schools, and corporate clients. Our operations include designing, engraving, and assembling awards using high-quality materials such as acrylic, glass, and metal. We prioritize quality control and maintain formalized processes to ensure that every product meets our customers’ expectations. Our shop is equipped with modern laser engravers and CNC machines, which we regularly maintain and inspect. We offer a secure and controlled environment for our high-value inventory, with documented training for all staff operating machinery. Enhanced shipping procedures are in place to guarantee safe delivery of orders, and we partner with vetted subcontractors for specialized engraving work, ensuring that they adhere to insurance requirements. By fostering strong relationships with reliable suppliers, we are able to provide timely and quality materials to meet fluctuating demand.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 07/15/2023, a package containing trophies was damaged during shipment due to improper handling by the courier service. The replacement cost amounted to $1,200. The claim is currently under review and we are working with the shipping provider to resolve the issue.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM to 6 PM, Saturday: 10 AM to 2 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty safe, Class B, UL-rated for burglary protection.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure storage area with access control and regular security patrols.

FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Trophy Master Awards does sponsor athletic teams as part of our commitment to supporting local communities and youth activities. We provide customized trophies and awards for various sporting events and teams.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are required to provide a certificate of insurance to mitigate liability exposure. The Operations Manager is responsible for checking these certificates to ensure compliance.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Trophy Master Awards has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Trophy Master Awards does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our staffing is entirely managed in-house to maintain consistency and control over operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Trophy Master Awards carries Workers’ Compensation insurance to ensure compliance and protect against employee-related risks. This policy is active and covers all eligible employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Trophy Master Awards also operates Trophy Masters Engraving Services, providing additional customization services for awards and trophies. This allows us to expand our offerings and better serve our clients.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Trophy Master Awards currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company. We maintain our primary policy along with compliance through our existing coverage.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Trophy Master Awards is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging products. Our focus is primarily on the retail of customized trophies and awards.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Trophy Master Awards does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus solely on the retail of customized trophies and awards. This practice helps us maintain control over our high-quality equipment and prevents liability exposure.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Trophy Master Awards has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial status and adheres to sound financial practices.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Trophy Master Awards does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus on the retail of customized trophies and awards using safe materials. We prioritize safety and compliance in all aspects of our business.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Trophy Master Awards does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are primarily focused on retailing customized trophies and awards without involvement in high-risk activities. We maintain strict safety protocols and insurance coverage to mitigate potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Trophy Master Awards has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize maintaining a safe and inclusive environment for all employees and clients.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Trophy Master Awards has no uncorrected fire code violations and prioritizes compliance with all safety regulations to ensure a secure environment for both employees and customers.
